info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Retail Orders Tracks-v1-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Tracking API provides a seamless way for businesses to monitor the status and progress of their retail orders. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve detailed tracking information for orders, facilitating better supply chain management and customer support. Typical users include retailers and logistics providers looking to enhance their order fulfillment processes. By providing real-time updates on order status, businesses can improve customer experiences and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the tracking information for a specified order. By providing the order ID, you can get real-time updates on the status and location of your order.

requestBody.description: Request body for tracking an order. This should contain the necessary parameters to identify the order being tracked.

201.description: The tracking information for the order was successfully created.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: This schema represents the expected request body format for the GET operation related to tracking orders.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_201.title: Order Tracking Response

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the order tracking.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the tracking operation.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_201.description: Response schema for the order tracking operation, indicating the status and details of the tracking request.

AuditInformation.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed by an automated system.

AuditInformation.description: Describes the audit information related to an operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This can help identify performance bottlenecks in the API's response.
